questions.question: What is the primary benefit of React 19 Server Components over traditional client-rendered components?
options: They remove heavy JavaScript dependencies from the client bundle and render on the server
They force all database queries to run in browser memory
They only run inside React Native apps
questions.explanation: React Server Components execute strictly on the server and stream serialized UI to the client without sending their component dependencies to the browser bundle.

questions.question: In TypeScript, what does the keyof operator produce when applied to an interface?
options: A runtime array of object keys
A union type of string or numeric literal keys of the given type
A boolean check for property existence
questions.explanation: keyof T yields a union of all known public property names of type T at compile time.

questions.question: Which HTTP status code is most appropriate when a client request lacks valid authentication credentials?
questions.explanation: 401 Unauthorized signifies that the request requires user authentication.

blog.title: The AI Engineering Paradigm Shift: Beyond Simple Prompting in 2026
blog.author: Dr. Surya K.
blog.excerpt: Why software engineering teams are shifting from prompt hacking to deterministic agent architectures, evaluation harnesses, and synthetic training data.
blog.content: Modern tech companies no longer seek engineers who merely know how to call an LLM API. The industry demand has matured into structural AI engineering: creating verifiable deterministic systems, robust vector databases, self-correcting agent chains, and parameter-efficient adapters. At HKSURYA Learning, our curriculum focuses on first-principles understanding so you can build robust systems that survive production traffic.

blog.title: Architecting High-Throughput Applications with React 19 & Server Components
blog.author: Maya Chen
blog.excerpt: A practical breakdown of how React 19 eliminates client-side waterfall bottlenecks and transforms frontend architectures.
blog.content: React 19 brings unified Server Actions, simplified form state handling, and seamless asset preloading. When combined with modern 3D graphics in WebGL, web applications can now deliver desktop-grade performance directly inside modern browsers. Here is how we structure our enterprise projects at HKSURYA Learning.
